limitations: Arabic arSA text and speech identifiers appear in local build tags, but this does not prove Arabic assets are installed or retrievable for this exact build.
The language .reg files are settings snippets, not translation packages; they were read as plain text only.
Archive internals were not extracted or parsed; destination paths and safe replacement method are not established.
Arabic shaping, bidirectional ordering, glyph coverage, UI layout, and actual in-game Arabic support require a real compatible package and controlled testing.
The installed locale cannot be determined from the inspected LAZR registry key because it is absent.
implementationGate: Non-destructive launcher foundations such as detection, reporting, package manifest validation, and normal launching can proceed. Installation and restoration must remain disabled until a real Campaign Remastered-compatible package is supplied, its archive/destination method is documented, and Arabic behavior is validated.
